draft.body:
## Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings

## 1
Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

The Federal Reserve Board on Tuesday released the minutes from its recent meetings to review and determine the discount rates provided to depository institutions through the discount window. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 2
The minutes from today cover the Board meetings held on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 3
The Board's process for setting the discount rate differs from the process that Federal Open Market Committee uses to set the target range for the federal funds rate. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]

## 4
For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955. [source:873093a8-085e-42b5-8bb2-657f62f8df94]
